excludedAuthors.reason: authors nearly every PR; GitHub never requests review from a PR's own author, so listing the usual author would silently resolve to nobody

codeowners.enforcementRationale: effective approver pool is only 2 people (abenrhouma, adammeg); enabling requireCodeOwnerReview would turn an ordinary availability dip into a hard merge block on every PR. required_approving_review_count=1 already guarantees a human approves.

invariantsNeverBypassed: auto-merge only merges once every required gate is already satisfied; it never lowers a gate
agentLoop: agent fixes review feedback and resolves threads
GitHub merges automatically once every rule passes

mergeMethodPolicy.rationale: last 60 PRs merged into main: 57 merge commits, 3 squash (latest 2026-08-26), 0 rebase. Rebase removal is a provable no-op; squash removal is a real behaviour change, accepted for auditability, SHA provenance and stacked-PR history mapping.

humanOnlyBoundary.description: Final approval of a pull request. The agent never submits any approving review, on any PR, including its own.
Supplying a new secret value the agent does not already hold.
GitHub Support requests that have no API path.
Any new destructive or unforeseen governance exception, or any ruleset/branch-protection bypass actor.
Deleting the classic branch protection rule (BPR_kwDOPXufyc4EGsZG). Requires its own operator gate — see apply-governance.mjs --delete-classic-protection.
Any change to production deploy access, including the repository's single write-capable deploy key (see docs/audits/2026-08-29-github-governance-inventory.md for its identity and last-used date).
